levels.surface: محمد بن أحمد بن يحيى بن عمران الأشعري

notes: «حدثنا أبي - رحمه الله -» opens with the compiler's father: relation; the blessing is left out
«سئل أبو عبد الله» is passive and names no asker, so there is no named asker link; the Imam is the last link (owner ruling 2)
«[و]» is an editorial bracket in the text; kept in the surface so it matches the text
